note: Single-pass extraction by Claude reading the paper text; evidence references sections/figures/tables. No multi-run validation.

components.description: CateKV: from KV-cache limits and sequential consistency to the hybrid method and its accuracy/efficiency results

nodes.name: Long-context inference is costly
nodes.description: As context grows, LLM inference needs to store and retrieve all KV caches, so latency and memory rise; for Llama-3-8B-Instruct-262k with FlashAttention, going from 1K to 1M tokens raises latency by over 3000x.

nodes.name: KV eviction loses accuracy
nodes.description: KV eviction methods discard KV pairs by predefined policies, usually causing significant accuracy loss because essential information is removed.

nodes.name: KV retrieval keeps high memory
nodes.description: KV retrieval methods keep all KV pairs and retrieve relevant tokens at decoding, preserving accuracy but not mitigating memory usage, which limits batch size and throughput.

nodes.name: Sequential consistency of heads
nodes.description: Some attention heads concentrate on a few critical tokens consistently across pre-filling and decoding (consistent heads), while others vary significantly across decoding steps with broad attention (adaptive heads); this occurs across different LLMs and layers.

nodes.name: Critical tokens found at pre-fill
nodes.description: For consistent heads, critical tokens can be identified from the pre-filling stage using the attention of the last Lobs query tokens (observation window) and used to guide decoding.

nodes.name: CV-based head classification
nodes.description: CateKV classifies heads into consistent and adaptive types using a coefficient-of-variation-based score over a reference dataset, and classification results are highly similar across samples.

nodes.name: CateKV hybrid cache
nodes.description: CateKV retains only a small budget of critical KV pairs in consistent heads (chunk-level top-k) and most KV pairs (retention ratio eta) in adaptive heads, chosen by pre-filling attention weights.

nodes.name: Theoretical bound
nodes.description: A Rademacher-complexity bound on the CV-based classifier's generalization (Lemma 1) bounds the head-classification accuracy P_head that drives CateKV's eviction performance.

nodes.name: Accuracy near full attention on RULER
nodes.description: On RULER at 128K with r=0.4, eta=1.0 and a consistent-head budget of 2048, CateKV keeps about 41% of the KV cache, outperforms StreamingLLM, SnapKV, PyramidKV and DuoAttention, and is comparable to full attention.

nodes.name: LongBench accuracy retained
nodes.description: On LongBench, CateKV reduces KV cache to 42% across five LLMs with an average accuracy decline of at most 0.3%; combined with Quest or ShadowKV the decrease is at most 0.2%.

nodes.name: Better than DuoAttention at low full-head ratios
nodes.description: DuoAttention's accuracy declines notably when retrieval heads fall below 0.3 of heads, while CateKV stays near full attention even at an adaptive-head ratio of 0.1, because consistent heads capture cross-query similarity whereas streaming heads cover initial and recent tokens.

nodes.name: Single-sample efficiency
nodes.description: In single-sample inference, generic settings (r=0.4, eta=1.0) give Phi-3 2.11x memory and 1.79x latency reductions, and a tuned setting gives Llama-3 up to 2.72x memory and 2.18x decoding latency reductions with under 0.25% accuracy decline.

nodes.name: Batch throughput
nodes.description: In batch inference at 40K tokens, generic settings give up to 2.38x batch size and 2.25x throughput, and further compression on Llama-3 gives 4.33x batch size and 3.96x throughput.

isolated_nodes.name: Integration with MInference
isolated_nodes.description: Combining CateKV with the pre-filling accelerator MInference on RULER (8K-256K) causes no performance degradation and even slight improvement, showing sequential consistency is unaffected by pre-filling patterns.

isolated_nodes.name: Retention ratio threshold
isolated_nodes.description: In adaptive heads, when eta exceeds about 0.6 the model matches or surpasses full-KV performance, below that accuracy drops significantly, and latency falls linearly as eta decreases.

isolated_nodes.name: Robust to consistent-head budget
isolated_nodes.description: CateKV shows strong robustness across different sparse budgets for consistent heads (Fig 8c).

structural_reasoning: Problem framing of eviction versus retrieval motivates the sequential-consistency observation, which grounds head classification and the hybrid cache; accuracy and efficiency results build on the method. Ablations are isolated.
